findings.summary: The packet does not establish an 8.7.1 release candidate or release-quality run for the reviewed target commit.
evidence: The release record, claims review, observer record, and install readback all identify version 8.7.0 and tag v8.7.0.
The pre-push quality receipt verifies head c10b107b5412b5b3ab093e5c305c56409fa74f1a, while the reviewed target is 98431a41c0e0b977a4431fc62a46817237d2a9e5.
The claims review is bound to prepared commit 1d51de8a661805505794be554b478f0ced510b46, which precedes the reviewed patch range.
No reviewed input demonstrates 8.7.1 version surfaces, an 8.7.1 claims review, or a quality receipt bound to the final 8.7.1 candidate.
findings.action: Prepare the 8.7.1 release surfaces and rerun the release-quality and claims-review gates against the final candidate commit; bind the resulting receipts to that exact head before lock-in.

findings.summary: The mutation-probe change materially expands candidate scanning and import-closure analysis, but the packet supplies only a prior quality receipt rather than execution evidence for this reviewed revision.
evidence: tests_referencing_paths now reads both standing-test sources and the mutation-pool production modules, builds AST dependency maps, and computes a transitive closure for every test.
The reviewed tests cover representative mapping shapes and ordering, but the supplied quality receipt is not bound to the reviewed target commit.
The packet reports a historical 8.7.0 release-full-superset pass, not a focused or full validation of the changed mutation probe at 98431a41c0e0b977a4431fc62a46817237d2a9e5.
findings.action: Run the focused mutation mapper/sampler tests and the release read-only quality gate at the final candidate head, preserving runtime and correctness evidence.

counterweight_triage.concern: Muse receives no Codex-style additional writable directories.
counterweight_triage.disposition: The implementation and documentation consistently treat Muse as having one effective workspace rooted at the lane worktree; the focused test verifies exactly one --workspace and the trusted-workspace flag.

counterweight_triage.concern: Round-robin mutation target selection can spend fewer slots on a broadly referenced file.
counterweight_triage.disposition: The behavior directly addresses starvation of sibling changed files, preserves deduplication, and is covered by a multi-path budget test.

counterweight_triage.concern: The v8.7.0 public-page HTTP observation does not prove a GitHub Release object exists.
counterweight_triage.disposition: Both the observer record and release narrative explicitly state this limitation; release existence is attributed separately to the release backend.

next_move: Do not lock 8.7.1. Generate candidate-specific 8.7.1 release metadata and rerun focused plus release-quality verification at the exact final commit, then obtain a fresh bounded review over those receipts and the same code paths.
non_claims: This review does not reject the apparent direction of either patch fix.
This review does not treat the historical 8.7.0 release evidence as proof for the 8.7.1 candidate.
No workspace state or unbound files were inspected.
